rationale: The plan correctly diagnoses the fatal limitation of a 1v1 design, states that within-condition variance is unestimable, makes a descriptive TMM-CPM log2FC ranking the primary deliverable, and specifies the replication needed (>=3, preferably >=5 per arm) — this is the core of the reference answer and is well executed, with descriptive QC (library sizes, detection rates, top-fraction genes, MA and scatter plots) appropriate to n=2 and a minimal, justified CPM>=1 filter. It nonetheless departs from the reference by running edgeR exactTest with fixed BCVs of 0.1/0.2/0.4 and reporting FDR<0.05 gene counts; the framing as an assumption-sensitivity demonstration is honest and clearly labelled, but it still produces p-values and FDR numbers the design cannot support, and a reader could lift them as a discovery list. There is no design formula or contrast to specify beyond a stated direction convention, which the plan does give; no shrinkage of the reported effect sizes is proposed, only a pseudocount. Enrichment is not warranted here — a permutation GSEA on a single-pair ranking manufactures an apparent null — and although the plan uses the full ranked list, a named human collection, a size window, a seed and a universe-overlap report, it should have been omitted or reduced to a purely descriptive readout; no collection version is given.
